name: luna-pool-orchestrator
description: TASK_DAG_V1 orchestration with READY dependencies, leases, progressive 1/2/4 widening, affinity scheduling, candidate-bound challenges, and token-free status.

interface.shortDescription: Low-cost Luna work with visible Sol governance.
interface.longDescription: Heliolune's compact start_task path builds a validated TASK_DAG_V1 and adaptively widens from one to two or four Luna/max workers. READY dependencies, read/write leases, critical-path priority, path affinity, completion quorum, queued cancellation, and exact candidate fingerprints are deterministic. Throughput and legacy speed-first remain explicit, while token-first is the safety fallback. Mutations use detached Git worktrees and safe-apply gates; post-patch challenges use a different worker and exact candidate checkout. Sol retains architecture, risk, integration review, and final acceptance. A native Windows panel shows token-free live status.
defaultPrompt: Use $luna-pool-orchestrator adaptive TASK_DAG_V1 start for one bounded task; await once and return compact evidence to Sol.
Use $luna-pool-orchestrator in token-first fallback mode because parallel write isolation is unsafe here.
